turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What took, brought you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I'm just feeling, so, I do have COPD, but I just feel so much worse. I do have shortness of breath, but I think it's just been worse over the past three days. I'm having more difficulty climbing stairs, or even just going to the bathroom.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you said this started?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Three days ago, three or four days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And since that time has the shortness of breath been getting worse or staying the same?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so initially it was just, it was just climbing stairs, you know, but then after that, I mean, this morning, I was just short of breath going to the bathroom.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had, uh, shortness of breath on exertion like this before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, you know, sometimes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't, do much anyway, because my CPD, you know, just makes things a little bit difficult, uh, yeah, I use my puffers.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any, uh, episodes where you've woken up in the middle of the night and were really short of breath, you had to, uh, sit up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and are you able to lie flat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you mentioned you were bringing up sputum. Could you describe the color?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I don't know it's kinda yellow, uh, green.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Has that changed from before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, so usually it's just sort of whiteish and foamy, and uh, yeah it's different. And it's more, you know, it's alot more, every time I'm coughing it's just like, spoonfuls, it's a lot more than usual.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah, it sounds like a lot more and have you noticed any blood?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uh, so have you had a cough then?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, I've had a cough for the past 20 years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is your cough worse at any particular time of the day, Or does it happen throughout the day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, it's a bit worse when I'm smoking, but otherwise it's the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has your cough been worse these past couple of days as well?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about any ear pain or eye pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had a loss of smell or a loss of taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any wheezing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: A little bit. It's been there for a while though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed any changes to the wheeze?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't think so. I don't know. I can't tell.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, OK, and have you had any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any lightheadedness or dizziness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any heart palpitations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and have you had any abdominal pain, nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and any urinary problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any bowel problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any changes to your skin or any rashes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think I was feeling very chilly last night. My wife had to bring an extra blanket for me.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uh, have you checked your temperature?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I didn't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, we'll certainly check that today. And have you had any weight loss in the last several months?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't check my weight very often, but no, uh, yeah, my clothes still fit, they're all, they're fine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, fair enough and, uh, have you noticed any, like, leg swelling or any swelling in your belly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and in regards to your past health, you mentioned COPD, but have you been diagnosed with any other medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I have high blood pressure, and my cholesterol is also a little bit on the high side.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, OK and you use puffers. Do you use any other medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I think my doc prescribed some pills, I don't know, I don't remember what they are, I just take them every day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, we can get that information. Have you had any hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I've been to the ER a couple of times and this one time, it was similar to this time, when I was having difficulties breathing and had to stay for about five days or so. I think that was two years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how are your symptoms feeling now when compared to, uh, that time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I wasn't producing this green yellow thing that's coming out of my mouth right now. It was not that bad. It's just last time I was having difficulties breathing, so I decided to come in. But this time I just have this weird thing, I don't even feel like looking at it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah, for sure it sounds like there's something certainly going on here and Yeah, have you had any past surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I had, uh, I had a knee replacement.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and, uh, can you tell me a little bit about your living situation, like who do you live with and whereabouts?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I live with my wife about ten minutes away from here. We live in an apartment, uh, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you working, are you retired?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I retired two years ago. I used to work at Chrysler, as a mechanic.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you been around anybody who might be sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, how about, have you traveled anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've just been staying indoors. My wife's been staying with me. We're both pretty careful, we're worried about catching covid so we don't even go out for groceries, we just have those delivery guys come and bring us our groceries.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you smoke cigarettes, you mentioned, how much do you smoke per day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I smoke about a pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how long have you smoked for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Let's see, about forty-five years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you thought about quitting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, multiple doctors have told me to quit and it's just, I don't think I can quit. It's not gonna happen. I can't live without my cigarettes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, the door is always open and certainly something we can talk about at anytime, uh, if you'd like to, but, uh, in the meantime, we'll leave it alone for now. I was wondering if you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I drink a glass or two every weekend.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do use any other recreational drugs like marijuana, cocaine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and, any family history of heart or lung conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, high blood pressure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, has anybody in the family had lung cancer?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and, so you've been experiencing worsening sputum production that now has a green color to it, and now having a bit more, more short of breath, which sounds like COPD exacerbation, especially since it's a similar type of presentation as before. And so we'll order a chest X-ray, some blood gases and do a sputum culture and possibly start antibiotics, but, depending on the severity we may not not need to just yet. And then we'll also use some inhalers as well as inhaled steroid to help with the inflammation in the airways.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, we'll get that started.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Thank you.
